notes: Local Apache Spark 4.0.4 on one machine in local[2] mode with the web UI disabled and spark.sql.shuffle.partitions=4. Adaptive execution, the broadcast threshold and, in test 14, two adaptive size thresholds scaled to toy size are the only settings changed, one test at a time. Plans, partition membership, stage/task counts and shuffle records (read from Spark's status store, the store the web UI renders) are Spark's own output; no wall-clock time is asserted or reported as a benchmark. Nothing ran on Databricks.
